issue.title: test_cpu_memory_usage.py does not pass negative test

failure.body:
**Description**

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. start yes > /dev/null on the dut
2. yes process will occupy 100% cpu for one core
3. run test_cpu_memory_usage.py

**Describe the results you received:**
test pass

